meta.name: Generative Fill (Qwen-Image-Edit-2511, Lightning 8 steps, mask-guided, slower)
meta.licenseNote: Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 is Apache-2.0 (Alibaba Qwen, 2025-12-23); the Lightning LoRA is Apache-2.0 (lightx2v, 2026-01).
meta.promptFormat: Image 2 is a mask of image 1: the white area marks the only part of image 1 to change. Edit image 1 so that the white area of image 2 shows {prompt}, fitting the scene's perspective, lighting and surroundings naturally. Keep everything outside that area exactly as it is.
meta.promptFormatImperative: Image 2 is a mask of image 1: the white area marks the only part of image 1 to change. Inside that area: {prompt}. Fit the result to the scene naturally and keep everything outside that area exactly as it is.
meta.notes: `fill-lightning-8` plus the selection mask as `image2` of both TextEncodeQwenImageEditPlus nodes (scaled like image 1) and an instruction that names it, so the model knows where the edit goes: the latent noise mask alone confines the change but does not tell the model about it. Measured 2026-10-09 (docs/comfy/benchmarks.md §3): the best placement of the 2511 variants, at 1.5–3× the time of `fill-lightning-8` because the second reference image adds another ~1 MP of tokens. Opt-in from the picker; `auto` does not choose it.
meta.creator: Alibaba Qwen
meta.description: Shows the model where the selection is: best placement, slower
